items.title: Family pays tribute to 'warm and engaging' man killed in tiger attack
items.summary: William Chapman was attacked by the tiger after he entered its pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park.

items.title: One stolen every four minutes - inside the police battle against vehicle thieves
items.summary: Officers tell the BBC they are overstretched and struggling to keep up with sophisticated criminals.

items.title: Watch: BBC joins police on front line against car theft
items.summary: Investigations reporter NJ Convery has been out on a nighttime hunt for vehicle thieves.

items.title: Russian strikes leave 600,000 without power in Ukraine, Zelensky says
items.summary: Ukraine's president says "critical" infrastructure was hit overnight, while emergency services say at least three were killed.

items.title: Pope diagnosed with lung cancer but had successful surgery, Vatican says
items.summary: Pope Leo had a "peaceful night" in the hospital after the surgery to remove a lower lobe of his right lung, the Vatican says.

items.title: Saudi man charged with planting 'sophisticated' recording device in OpenAI office
items.summary: Prosecutors say the device, wrapped in toilet paper, was found inserted in a USB port on the back of a TV in an executive conference room.

items.title: World's oldest shipwreck found off coast of Turkey
items.summary: Archaeologists say the wreck is up to 4,700 years old, dating to the Early Bronze Age.

items.title: Saudi Arabia overturns death sentence for man over Facebook comment, Sri Lanka says
items.summary: Anojan Sivarasa's case sent shockwaves through Sri Lanka, spurring diplomatic efforts to seek clemency.
